svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Mint Tilt FSNY logo, v3
svg.desc: FSNY provides a compact lettermark variation of the chosen mint tag. The face and initials share the gentle tilt while the attached local base stays centered. Paired with the exact Free-Stuff-Near-You name in deep green. Original, unadopted concept with editable text and transparent surroundings.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Trebuchet MS, Arial, sans-serif
